newsitem.title: CROATIA: Tudjman medal for Croat war crimes suspect.
newsitem.headline: Tudjman medal for Croat war crimes suspect.

text.p: Croatian President Franjo Tudjman has awarded a former Bosnian Croat army commander indicted by the U.N. War crimes tribunal a medal for military actions in 1995, a newspaper said on Sunday.
Slobodna Dalmacija newspaper said General Tihomir Blaskic was decorated for his part in Croatia's recapture of the rebel Serb enclave of Knin Krajina in southern Croatia.

Blaskic, who surrendered to The Hague-based tribunal in April, is charged with crimes agaist Moslem civilians in central Bosnia during Moslem-Croat war in 1992 and 1993 when he was commander of Bosnian Croat forces.
He was promoted to a senior post in Croatia's regular army after his indictment by the court.
His medal was received by his wife at a ceremony in the Croat-controlled Bosnian town of Posusje on Saturday.
The court has indicted over 70 Serbs, Croats and Moslems for alleged war crimes but has only seven in custody. Blaskic's trial is due to begin in the spring.
